reasons.archive-regression: a synthetic regression of archive-mode chronology
reasons.history: executes a git subprocess, a host-environment read, a seal-state read or a filesystem read of verification/seals/ (the kinds are listed with the row)
reasons.records: every file it reads is a legacy record
reasons.adjudicated: read by hand; the adjudication is listed with the row
reasons.machinery: tests the retired machinery its infrastructure round installed
reasons.unresolved: a read site does not resolve statically
reasons.computation: reads no file: an exact computation over constants
reasons.live: reads a file outside the legacy records

adjudications: compares the seal records of HYA, HYB and HYE, read from verification/seals/ through the record reader, with constants, and reads the HYE preregistration
the drift control of a redundant freeze pin: the pin run with a reader that appends one byte to the pinned record, so it reads only that record
the mutation control of the HYE seal comparison, run on a fabricated seal state
row_format: files read, as indices into files_read
first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the statement's unparsed text
